# Generated by mods/where_to_produce/tools/generate.py. Do not edit by hand.
#
# The plan editor. Everything here changes a plan that already exists and
# **nothing here re-runs the plan**: `bag_wtp_plan_run` is the only thing that
# does, and pressing it throws every edit away, which is why the save slot exists.

# Which good the editor is pointed at, taken from the button that was pressed.
#
# **The good arrives as a scope and is turned into the plan's own index here.**
# Every counter the plan keeps is numbered -- `_pn<n>`, `_p<n>`, `_pm<n>` -- and
# a scope cannot index them, so this is the one place the two meet. It was three
# CMM dropdowns read out of a global variable map; a window of icons needs none
# of that, and `scope:x = goods:y` is the game's own way of asking (its
# `situation_triggers.txt` compares saved goods scopes exactly so).
#
# `_edit_good` at 0 means the scope named a good this ground has no plan for,
# and every caller checks it.
# Scope: country
bag_wtp_edit_set_good = {
	set_variable = { name = bag_wtp_edit_good value = 0 }
	if = { limit = { scope:bag_wtp_good = goods:clay } set_variable = { name = bag_wtp_edit_good value = 1 } }
	if = { limit = { scope:bag_wtp_good = goods:coal } set_variable = { name = bag_wtp_edit_good value = 2 } }
	if = { limit = { scope:bag_wtp_good = goods:cotton } set_variable = { name = bag_wtp_edit_good value = 3 } }

	if = { limit = { scope:bag_wtp_good = goods:porcelain } set_variable = { name = bag_wtp_edit_good value = 41 } }
	if = { limit = { scope:bag_wtp_good = goods:pottery } set_variable = { name = bag_wtp_edit_good value = 42 } }
	if = { limit = { scope:bag_wtp_good = goods:slaves_goods } set_variable = { name = bag_wtp_edit_good value = 43 } }
	if = { limit = { scope:bag_wtp_good = goods:steel } set_variable = { name = bag_wtp_edit_good value = 44 } }
	if = { limit = { scope:bag_wtp_good = goods:tar } set_variable = { name = bag_wtp_edit_good value = 45 } }
	if = { limit = { scope:bag_wtp_good = goods:tools } set_variable = { name = bag_wtp_edit_good value = 46 } }
	if = { limit = { scope:bag_wtp_good = goods:weaponry } set_variable = { name = bag_wtp_edit_good value = 47 } }
	# **Whether the press arrived at all, kept apart from whether it did
	# anything.** A button that never reaches its effect and a rule that refuses
	# look identical on screen, and telling them apart used to cost a log and a
	# round trip. `_edit_reached` is 0 when the good never came through the scope,
	# so `bag_wtp_edit_last_label` can say «кнопка не донесла товар» instead of
	# blaming a rule.
	set_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_edit_reached value = 0 }
	if = {
		limit = { var:bag_wtp_edit_good > 0 }
		set_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_edit_reached value = 1 }
	}
}

# The building this location would give up most cheaply, and which good it is.
#
# `-1` in `_esw` means "nothing here may be taken out at all" -- every building
# is either its good's last on the ground or part of the town's charter bundle.
# **A gain of nought is a real answer and `-1` is not**, which is why the empty
# marker cannot be nought: a good the ground feeds nothing is exactly the one an
# edit should be taking out first.
# Scope: location

				NOT = { bag_wtp_edit_locked_1 = yes }
				OR = {
					var:bag_wtp_esw = -1
					var:bag_wtp_p1 < var:bag_wtp_esw
				}
			}
			set_variable = { name = bag_wtp_esw value = var:bag_wtp_p1 }
			set_variable = { name = bag_wtp_esg value = 1 }

# clay: what every candidate would charge for one more of it.
# Scope: country
bag_wtp_edit_scan_1 = {
	every_in_global_list = {
		variable = bag_wtp_candidates
		if = {
			limit = { bag_wtp_edit_fits_town_1 = yes }
			if = {
				limit = { var:bag_wtp_load < global_var:bag_wtp_plan_cap_urban }
				# A free room costs nothing, so it always outbids an eviction.
				set_variable = { name = bag_wtp_esc value = 1 }
				set_variable = { name = bag_wtp_esv value = var:bag_wtp_p1 }
				change_variable = { name = bag_wtp_esv add = 1000 }
			}
			else_if = {
				limit = { var:bag_wtp_esw >= 0 }
				set_variable = { name = bag_wtp_esc value = 1 }
				set_variable = { name = bag_wtp_esv value = var:bag_wtp_p1 }
				change_variable = { name = bag_wtp_esv subtract = var:bag_wtp_esw }
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = { bag_wtp_edit_fits_rural_1 = yes }
			if = {
				limit = { var:bag_wtp_load < global_var:bag_wtp_plan_cap_rural }
				# A free room costs nothing, so it always outbids an eviction.
				set_variable = { name = bag_wtp_esc value = 1 }
				set_variable = { name = bag_wtp_esv value = var:bag_wtp_pr1 }
				change_variable = { name = bag_wtp_esv add = 1000 }
			}
			else_if = {
				limit = { var:bag_wtp_esw >= 0 }
				set_variable = { name = bag_wtp_esc value = 1 }
				set_variable = { name = bag_wtp_esv value = var:bag_wtp_pr1 }
				change_variable = { name = bag_wtp_esv subtract = var:bag_wtp_esw }
			}
		}
	}
}

# steel: what every candidate would charge for one more of it.
# Scope: country
bag_wtp_edit_scan_44 = {
	every_in_global_list = {
		variable = bag_wtp_candidates
		if = {
			limit = { bag_wtp_edit_fits_town_44 = yes }
			if = {
				limit = { var:bag_wtp_load < global_var:bag_wtp_plan_cap_urban }
				# A free room costs nothing, so it always outbids an eviction.
				set_variable = { name = bag_wtp_esc value = 1 }
				set_variable = { name = bag_wtp_esv value = var:bag_wtp_p44 }
				change_variable = { name = bag_wtp_esv add = 1000 }
			}
			else_if = {
				limit = { var:bag_wtp_esw >= 0 }

				set_variable = { name = bag_wtp_esv value = var:bag_wtp_p44 }

# clay out of this location, town side.
#
# **Every counter the plan keeps is walked back**, because the report and the
# next edit both read them: the load, the total placed, this good's own count,
# and the two gain counters the header prints.
# Scope: location
bag_wtp_edit_remove_town_1 = {
	if = {
		limit = { is_target_in_variable_list = { name = bag_wtp_plan_goods target = goods:clay } }
		remove_list_variable = { name = bag_wtp_plan_goods target = goods:clay }
		if = {
			limit = { OR = {
				var:bag_wtp_pm1 = 39
			} }
			remove_list_variable = { name = bag_wtp_plan_builds target = building_type:clay_pit }
		}
		change_variable = { name = bag_wtp_load subtract = 1 }
		change_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_plan_placed subtract = 1 }
		change_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_pn1 subtract = 1 }
		change_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_plan_gain subtract = var:bag_wtp_p1 }
		if = {
			limit = { var:bag_wtp_p1 > 0 }
			change_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_plan_fed subtract = 1 }
		}
	}
}

		limit = { is_target_in_variable_list = { name = bag_wtp_plan_goods target = goods:sugar } }
		remove_list_variable = { name = bag_wtp_plan_goods target = goods:sugar }
		if = {
			limit = { OR = {
				var:bag_wtp_prm21 = 212
			} }
			remove_list_variable = { name = bag_wtp_plan_builds target = building_type:sugar_plantation }
		}
		change_variable = { name = bag_wtp_load subtract = 1 }
		change_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_plan_placed subtract = 1 }
		change_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_pn21 subtract = 1 }
		change_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_plan_gain subtract = var:bag_wtp_pr21 }
		if = {
			limit = { var:bag_wtp_pr21 > 0 }
			change_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_plan_fed subtract = 1 }
		}
	}
}

# **One more building of the chosen good, and exactly one.**
#
# The ordered walk is the whole of the choice: `_esv` is what each candidate
# charges -- a free room charges nothing and outbids everything, an eviction
# charges the victim's gain -- so the highest is the least painful place, and
# `max = 1` takes it and stops. Both sides' effects are called and the one whose
# side the location is not simply does nothing, which is cheaper than asking.
# Scope: country
bag_wtp_edit_add = {
	set_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_edit_done value = 0 }
	if = {
		limit = { var:bag_wtp_edit_good > 0 }
		every_in_global_list = {
			variable = bag_wtp_candidates
			set_variable = { name = bag_wtp_esc value = 0 }
			set_variable = { name = bag_wtp_esv value = 0 }
			bag_wtp_edit_worst = yes
		}
		if = { limit = { var:bag_wtp_edit_good = 1 } bag_wtp_edit_scan_1 = yes }
		if = { limit = { var:bag_wtp_edit_good = 2 } bag_wtp_edit_scan_2 = yes }
		if = { limit = { var:bag_wtp_edit_good = 3 } bag_wtp_edit_scan_3 = yes }
		if = { limit = { var:bag_wtp_edit_good = 4 } bag_wtp_edit_scan_4 = yes }
		if = { limit = { var:bag_wtp_edit_good = 5 } bag_wtp_edit_scan_5 = yes }
		if = { limit = { var:bag_wtp_edit_good = 6 } bag_wtp_edit_scan_6 = yes }
		if = { limit = { var:bag_wtp_edit_good = 7 } bag_wtp_edit_scan_7 = yes }
		if = { limit = { var:bag_wtp_edit_good = 8 } bag_wtp_edit_scan_8 = yes }
		if = { limit = { var:bag_wtp_edit_good = 9 } bag_wtp_edit_scan_9 = yes }
		if = { limit = { var:bag_wtp_edit_good = 10 } bag_wtp_edit_scan_10 = yes }
		if = { limit = { var:bag_wtp_edit_good = 11 } bag_wtp_edit_scan_11 = yes }
		if = { limit = { var:bag_wtp_edit_good = 12 } bag_wtp_edit_scan_12 = yes }
		if = { limit = { var:bag_wtp_edit_good = 13 } bag_wtp_edit_scan_13 = yes }
		if = { limit = { var:bag_wtp_edit_good = 14 } bag_wtp_edit_scan_14 = yes }
		if = { limit = { var:bag_wtp_edit_good = 15 } bag_wtp_edit_scan_15 = yes }
		if = { limit = { var:bag_wtp_edit_good = 16 } bag_wtp_edit_scan_16 = yes }
		if = { limit = { var:bag_wtp_edit_good = 17 } bag_wtp_edit_scan_17 = yes }
		if = { limit = { var:bag_wtp_edit_good = 18 } bag_wtp_edit_scan_18 = yes }
		if = { limit = { var:bag_wtp_edit_good = 19 } bag_wtp_edit_scan_19 = yes }
		if = { limit = { var:bag_wtp_edit_good = 20 } bag_wtp_edit_scan_20 = yes }
		if = { limit = { var:bag_wtp_edit_good = 21 } bag_wtp_edit_scan_21 = yes }
		if = { limit = { var:bag_wtp_edit_good = 22 } bag_wtp_edit_scan_22 = yes }
		if = { limit = { var:bag_wtp_edit_good = 23 } bag_wtp_edit_scan_23 = yes }

# **One building of the chosen good taken out, and the room given to whatever
# suits it best afterwards.** «Он уступает место тому у чего забрал слоты.»
#
# The walk takes the good's *worst* placement, which is why the scan stores
# `1000 - gain`: `order_by` reads highest-first and there is no other way
# to ask it for a minimum.
# Scope: country
bag_wtp_edit_drop = {
	set_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_edit_done value = 0 }
	if = {
		limit = { var:bag_wtp_edit_good > 0 }
		every_in_global_list = {
			variable = bag_wtp_candidates
			set_variable = { name = bag_wtp_esc value = 0 }
			set_variable = { name = bag_wtp_esv value = 0 }
		}
		if = {
			limit = { var:bag_wtp_edit_good = 1 global_var:bag_wtp_pn1 > 1 }
			every_in_global_list = {
				variable = bag_wtp_candidates
				limit = { is_target_in_variable_list = { name = bag_wtp_plan_goods target = goods:clay } }
				set_variable = { name = bag_wtp_esc value = 1 }
				set_variable = { name = bag_wtp_esv value = 1000 }
				if = {
					limit = { bag_wtp_plan_is_town = yes }
					change_variable = { name = bag_wtp_esv subtract = var:bag_wtp_p1 }
				}
				else = {
					change_variable = { name = bag_wtp_esv subtract = var:bag_wtp_pr1 }
				}
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = { var:bag_wtp_edit_good = 2 global_var:bag_wtp_pn2 > 1 }
			every_in_global_list = {
				variable = bag_wtp_candidates
				limit = { is_target_in_variable_list = { name = bag_wtp_plan_goods target = goods:coal } }
				set_variable = { name = bag_wtp_esc value = 1 }
				set_variable = { name = bag_wtp_esv value = 1000 }
				if = {
					limit = { bag_wtp_plan_is_town = yes }
					change_variable = { name = bag_wtp_esv subtract = var:bag_wtp_p2 }
				}
				else = {
					change_variable = { name = bag_wtp_esv subtract = var:bag_wtp_pr2 }
				}
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = { var:bag_wtp_edit_good = 3 global_var:bag_wtp_pn3 > 1 }
			every_in_global_list = {
				variable = bag_wtp_candidates
				limit = { is_target_in_variable_list = { name = bag_wtp_plan_goods target = goods:cotton } }
				set_variable = { name = bag_wtp_esc value = 1 }
				set_variable = { name = bag_wtp_esv value = 1000 }
				if = {
					limit = { bag_wtp_plan_is_town = yes }
					change_variable = { name = bag_wtp_esv subtract = var:bag_wtp_p3 }
				}
				else = {
					change_variable = { name = bag_wtp_esv subtract = var:bag_wtp_pr3 }
				}
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = { var:bag_wtp_edit_good = 4 global_var:bag_wtp_pn4 > 1 }
			every_in_global_list = {
				variable = bag_wtp_candidates
				limit = { is_target_in_variable_list = { name = bag_wtp_plan_goods target = goods:dyes } }
				set_variable = { name = bag_wtp_esc value = 1 }
				set_variable = { name = bag_wtp_esv value = 1000 }
				if = {
					limit = { bag_wtp_plan_is_town = yes }
					change_variable = { name = bag_wtp_esv subtract = var:bag_wtp_p4 }
				}
				else = {
					change_variable = { name = bag_wtp_esv subtract = var:bag_wtp_pr4 }
				}
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = { var:bag_wtp_edit_good = 5 global_var:bag_wtp_pn5 > 1 }
			every_in_global_list = {
				variable = bag_wtp_candidates
				limit = { is_target_in_variable_list = { name = bag_wtp_plan_goods target = goods:fiber_crops } }
				set_variable = { name = bag_wtp_esc value = 1 }
				set_variable = { name = bag_wtp_esv value = 1000 }
				if = {
					limit = { bag_wtp_plan_is_town = yes }
					change_variable = { name = bag_wtp_esv subtract = var:bag_wtp_p5 }
				}
				else = {
					change_variable = { name = bag_wtp_esv subtract = var:bag_wtp_pr5 }
				}
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = { var:bag_wtp_edit_good = 6 global_var:bag_wtp_pn6 > 1 }
			every_in_global_list = {
				variable = bag_wtp_candidates
				limit = { is_target_in_variable_list = { name = bag_wtp_plan_goods target = goods:fish } }
				set_variable = { name = bag_wtp_esc value = 1 }
				set_variable = { name = bag_wtp_esv value = 1000 }
				if = {
					limit = { bag_wtp_plan_is_town = yes }
					change_variable = { name = bag_wtp_esv subtract = var:bag_wtp_p6 }

				set_variable = { name = bag_wtp_esg value = 42 }
			}
			if = {
				limit = {
					OR = { bag_wtp_edit_fits_town_43 = yes bag_wtp_edit_fits_rural_43 = yes }
					OR = {
						AND = { bag_wtp_plan_is_town = yes var:bag_wtp_p43 > var:bag_wtp_esw }
						AND = { bag_wtp_plan_is_town = no var:bag_wtp_pr43 > var:bag_wtp_esw }
					}
				}
				if = { limit = { bag_wtp_plan_is_town = yes }
					set_variable = { name = bag_wtp_esw value = var:bag_wtp_p43 } }
				else = { set_variable = { name = bag_wtp_esw value = var:bag_wtp_pr43 } }

			}
			if = {

					OR = { bag_wtp_edit_fits_town_44 = yes bag_wtp_edit_fits_rural_44 = yes }
					OR = {
						AND = { bag_wtp_plan_is_town = yes var:bag_wtp_p44 > var:bag_wtp_esw }
						AND = { bag_wtp_plan_is_town = no var:bag_wtp_pr44 > var:bag_wtp_esw }
					}

				if = { limit = { bag_wtp_plan_is_town = yes }
					set_variable = { name = bag_wtp_esw value = var:bag_wtp_p44 } }
				else = { set_variable = { name = bag_wtp_esw value = var:bag_wtp_pr44 } }

	bag_wtp_plan_rank = yes
	# **And the window's rows again.** A location the edit gave its first building
	# is not in `_plan_results` and would not appear until something else refilled
	# it; the goods already in a row read live off the location, so without this
	# an edit is half-visible, which is the worst of the three states.
	bag_wtp_plan_show = yes

# **The baseline every «изменено» is measured against.**
#
# Written by `bag_wtp_plan_run` as well, so a fresh plan is its own baseline and
# the changes list right after one is empty -- which is the true answer, since a
# new plan has not been edited. Saving a slot re-bases it too, and so does
# loading one: «показать изменения» always answers «что я поменял с тех пор, как
# сохранил или загрузил», and never «чем этот план отличается от какого-то
# другого».
#
# Only the goods are kept. The building each good used is `_pm<n>`, which the
# scoring pass writes and no edit touches, so restoring puts it back from the
# good alone and the baseline needs no second list.
# Scope: country
bag_wtp_edit_save = {
	clear_global_variable_list = bag_wtp_save_locs
	every_in_global_list = {
		variable = bag_wtp_plan_touched
		clear_variable_list = bag_wtp_save_goods
		if = { limit = { is_target_in_variable_list = { name = bag_wtp_plan_goods target = goods:clay } } add_to_variable_list = { name = bag_wtp_save_goods target = goods:clay } }
		if = { limit = { is_target_in_variable_list = { name = bag_wtp_plan_goods target = goods:coal } } add_to_variable_list = { name = bag_wtp_save_goods target = goods:coal } }
		if = { limit = { is_target_in_variable_list = { name = bag_wtp_plan_goods target = goods:cotton } } add_to_variable_list = { name = bag_wtp_save_goods target = goods:cotton } }
		if = { limit = { is_target_in_variable_list = { name = bag_wtp_plan_goods target = goods:dyes } } add_to_variable_list = { name = bag_wtp_save_goods target = goods:dyes } }
		if = { limit = { is_target_in_variable_list = { name = bag_wtp_plan_goods target = goods:fiber_crops } } add_to_variable_list = { name = bag_wtp_save_goods target = goods:fiber_crops } }
		if = { limit = { is_target_in_variable_list = { name = bag_wtp_plan_goods target = goods:fish } } add_to_variable_list = { name = bag_wtp_save_goods target = goods:fish } }
		if = { limit = { is_target_in_variable_list = { name = bag_wtp_plan_goods target = goods:fruit } } add_to_variable_list = { name = bag_wtp_save_goods target = goods:fruit } }
		if = { limit = { is_target_in_variable_list = { name = bag_wtp_plan_goods target = goods:horses } } add_to_variable_list = { name = bag_wtp_save_goods target = goods:horses } }
		if = { limit = { is_target_in_variable_list = { name = bag_wtp_plan_goods target = goods:incense } } add_to_variable_list = { name = bag_wtp_save_goods target = goods:incense } }
		if = { limit = { is_target_in_variable_list = { name = bag_wtp_plan_goods target = goods:iron } } add_to_variable_list = { name = bag_wtp_save_goods target = goods:iron } }
		if = { limit = { is_target_in_variable_list = { name = bag_wtp_plan_goods target = goods:ivory } } add_to_variable_list = { name = bag_wtp_save_goods target = goods:ivory } }
		if = { limit = { is_target_in_variable_list = { name = bag_wtp_plan_goods target = goods:livestock } } add_to_variable_list = { name = bag_wtp_save_goods target = goods:livestock } }
		if = { limit = { is_target_in_variable_list = { name = bag_wtp_plan_goods target = goods:lumber } } add_to_variable_list = { name = bag_wtp_save_goods target = goods:lumber } }
		if = { limit = { is_target_in_variable_list = { name = bag_wtp_plan_goods target = goods:medicaments } } add_to_variable_list = { name = bag_wtp_save_goods target = goods:medicaments } }
		if = { limit = { is_target_in_variable_list = { name = bag_wtp_plan_goods target = goods:salt } } add_to_variable_list = { name = bag_wtp_save_goods target = goods:salt } }
		if = { limit = { is_target_in_variable_list = { name = bag_wtp_plan_goods target = goods:saltpeter } } add_to_variable_list = { name = bag_wtp_save_goods target = goods:saltpeter } }
		if = { limit = { is_target_in_variable_list = { name = bag_wtp_plan_goods target = goods:sand } } add_to_variable_list = { name = bag_wtp_save_goods target = goods:sand } }
		if = { limit = { is_target_in_variable_list = { name = bag_wtp_plan_goods target = goods:silk } } add_to_variable_list = { name = bag_wtp_save_goods target = goods:silk } }
		if = { limit = { is_target_in_variable_list = { name = bag_wtp_plan_goods target = goods:silver } } add_to_variable_list = { name = bag_wtp_save_goods target = goods:silver } }
		if = { limit = { is_target_in_variable_list = { name = bag_wtp_plan_goods target = goods:stone } } add_to_variable_list = { name = bag_wtp_save_goods target = goods:stone } }

		if = { limit = { is_target_in_variable_list = { name = bag_wtp_plan_goods target = goods:cloth } } add_to_variable_list = { name = bag_wtp_save_goods target = goods:cloth } }

		if = { limit = { is_target_in_variable_list = { name = bag_wtp_plan_goods target = goods:liquor } } add_to_variable_list = { name = bag_wtp_save_goods target = goods:liquor } }
		if = { limit = { is_target_in_variable_list = { name = bag_wtp_plan_goods target = goods:masonry } } add_to_variable_list = { name = bag_wtp_save_goods target = goods:masonry } }
		if = { limit = { is_target_in_variable_list = { name = bag_wtp_plan_goods target = goods:naval_supplies } } add_to_variable_list = { name = bag_wtp_save_goods target = goods:naval_supplies } }
		if = { limit = { is_target_in_variable_list = { name = bag_wtp_plan_goods target = goods:paper } } add_to_variable_list = { name = bag_wtp_save_goods target = goods:paper } }
		if = { limit = { is_target_in_variable_list = { name = bag_wtp_plan_goods target = goods:porcelain } } add_to_variable_list = { name = bag_wtp_save_goods target = goods:porcelain } }
		if = { limit = { is_target_in_variable_list = { name = bag_wtp_plan_goods target = goods:pottery } } add_to_variable_list = { name = bag_wtp_save_goods target = goods:pottery } }
		if = { limit = { is_target_in_variable_list = { name = bag_wtp_plan_goods target = goods:slaves_goods } } add_to_variable_list = { name = bag_wtp_save_goods target = goods:slaves_goods } }
		if = { limit = { is_target_in_variable_list = { name = bag_wtp_plan_goods target = goods:steel } } add_to_variable_list = { name = bag_wtp_save_goods target = goods:steel } }
		if = { limit = { is_target_in_variable_list = { name = bag_wtp_plan_goods target = goods:tar } } add_to_variable_list = { name = bag_wtp_save_goods target = goods:tar } }
		if = { limit = { is_target_in_variable_list = { name = bag_wtp_plan_goods target = goods:tools } } add_to_variable_list = { name = bag_wtp_save_goods target = goods:tools } }
		if = { limit = { is_target_in_variable_list = { name = bag_wtp_plan_goods target = goods:weaponry } } add_to_variable_list = { name = bag_wtp_save_goods target = goods:weaponry } }
		set_variable = { name = bag_wtp_save_load value = var:bag_wtp_load }
		remove_variable = bag_wtp_save_right
		if = {
			limit = { has_variable = bag_wtp_plan_right }
			set_variable = { name = bag_wtp_save_right value = var:bag_wtp_plan_right }
		}
		add_to_global_variable_list = { name = bag_wtp_save_locs target = this }
	}
	set_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_save_n value = global_var:bag_wtp_plan_placed }
}

# Slot 1: the plan as it stands now, kept under a name of its own.
# Scope: country
bag_wtp_edit_store_1 = {
	clear_global_variable_list = bag_wtp_sl1_locs
	every_in_global_list = {
		variable = bag_wtp_plan_touched
		clear_variable_list = bag_wtp_sl1_goods
		if = { limit = { is_target_in_variable_list = { name = bag_wtp_plan_goods target = goods:clay } } add_to_variable_list = { name = bag_wtp_sl1_goods target = goods:clay } }

		set_variable = { name = bag_wtp_sl1_load value = var:bag_wtp_load }
		remove_variable = bag_wtp_sl1_right
		if = {
			limit = { has_variable = bag_wtp_plan_right }
			set_variable = { name = bag_wtp_sl1_right value = var:bag_wtp_plan_right }
		}
		add_to_global_variable_list = { name = bag_wtp_sl1_locs target = this }
	}
	set_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_sl1_n value = global_var:bag_wtp_plan_placed }
	set_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_sl1_locn value = global_var:bag_wtp_plan_shown }
	# The saved plan is what the next «показать изменения» is measured against.
	bag_wtp_edit_save = yes
}

# Slot 1 back onto the map, in place of whatever the plan holds now.
# Scope: country
bag_wtp_edit_load_1 = {
	if = {
		limit = { global_var:bag_wtp_sl1_n > 0 }
		bag_wtp_edit_clear_plan = yes
		every_in_global_list = {
			variable = bag_wtp_sl1_locs
			add_to_global_variable_list = { name = bag_wtp_plan_touched target = this }
			if = {
				limit = { has_variable = bag_wtp_sl1_right }
				set_variable = { name = bag_wtp_plan_right value = var:bag_wtp_sl1_right }
				# **The charter counters are rebuilt and not left where the last plan
				# put them.** `_rgiven<k>` is what the diagnosis prints as «выдано» and
				# `_plan_rightn` is the number on the window; a slot loaded over a plan
				# for other ground would otherwise report that ground's charters, which
				# is a wrong number rather than a missing one.
				change_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_plan_rightn add = 1 }
				if = { limit = { var:bag_wtp_sl1_right = 1 } change_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_rgiven1 add = 1 } }
				if = { limit = { var:bag_wtp_sl1_right = 2 } change_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_rgiven2 add = 1 } }
				if = { limit = { var:bag_wtp_sl1_right = 3 } change_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_rgiven3 add = 1 } }
				if = { limit = { var:bag_wtp_sl1_right = 4 } change_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_rgiven4 add = 1 } }

# Slot 2: the plan as it stands now, kept under a name of its own.
# Scope: country
bag_wtp_edit_store_2 = {
	clear_global_variable_list = bag_wtp_sl2_locs
	every_in_global_list = {
		variable = bag_wtp_plan_touched

	bag_wtp_edit_save = yes
}

	if = {

# Slot 3: the plan as it stands now, kept under a name of its own.
# Scope: country
bag_wtp_edit_store_3 = {
	clear_global_variable_list = bag_wtp_sl3_locs

		set_variable = { name = bag_wtp_sl3_load value = var:bag_wtp_load }
		remove_variable = bag_wtp_sl3_right
		if = {
			limit = { has_variable = bag_wtp_plan_right }
			set_variable = { name = bag_wtp_sl3_right value = var:bag_wtp_plan_right }
		}
		add_to_global_variable_list = { name = bag_wtp_sl3_locs target = this }
	}
	set_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_sl3_n value = global_var:bag_wtp_plan_placed }
	set_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_sl3_locn value = global_var:bag_wtp_plan_shown }
	# The saved plan is what the next «показать изменения» is measured against.
	bag_wtp_edit_save = yes
}

# Slot 3 back onto the map, in place of whatever the plan holds now.
# Scope: country
bag_wtp_edit_load_3 = {
	if = {
		limit = { global_var:bag_wtp_sl3_n > 0 }
		bag_wtp_edit_clear_plan = yes
		every_in_global_list = {
			variable = bag_wtp_sl3_locs
			add_to_global_variable_list = { name = bag_wtp_plan_touched target = this }
			if = {
				limit = { has_variable = bag_wtp_sl3_right }
				set_variable = { name = bag_wtp_plan_right value = var:bag_wtp_sl3_right }
				# **The charter counters are rebuilt and not left where the last plan
				# put them.** `_rgiven<k>` is what the diagnosis prints as «выдано» and
				# `_plan_rightn` is the number on the window; a slot loaded over a plan
				# for other ground would otherwise report that ground's charters, which
				# is a wrong number rather than a missing one.
				change_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_plan_rightn add = 1 }
				if = { limit = { var:bag_wtp_sl3_right = 1 } change_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_rgiven1 add = 1 } }
				if = { limit = { var:bag_wtp_sl3_right = 2 } change_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_rgiven2 add = 1 } }
				if = { limit = { var:bag_wtp_sl3_right = 3 } change_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_rgiven3 add = 1 } }
				if = { limit = { var:bag_wtp_sl3_right = 4 } change_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_rgiven4 add = 1 } }
				if = { limit = { var:bag_wtp_sl3_right = 5 } change_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_rgiven5 add = 1 } }

# Every location the plan stands on emptied, and every counter with it. Shared by
# the restore and by each slot's load, because a plan half-cleared is the failure
# that shows up as a number rather than as an error.
# Scope: country
bag_wtp_edit_clear_plan = {
	every_in_global_list = {
		variable = bag_wtp_plan_touched

# «Показать изменения»: every location where the plan now differs from the saved
# one, and nothing else.
#
# **It fills a window and writes the same report to the log.** The window is what
# he asked for -- «кнопка показать список изменений, которое откроет ещё одно
# окно» -- and the log line stays because `mods.bat -> «Забрать диагностику из игры»` and `tools/diag.py`
# already fold a location's `LD` lines into «изменено: убрано X; добавлено Y»,
# which is how a change gets into a session without a screenshot.
#
# **Two lists on the location and a count beside them.** `_chg_out` is what left,
# `_chg_in` is what arrived, and `_chg_n` is how many of both -- the count is
# there because a `limit` cannot ask whether a variable list is empty, and
# `bag_wtp_chg_locs` must hold only the locations that really moved. Only those
# are printed, so after one edit the whole report is two lines, which is the
# point of the thing.
# Scope: country
bag_wtp_edit_changes = {
	set_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_edit_moved value = 0 }
	clear_global_variable_list = bag_wtp_chg_locs
	debug_log_date = yes
	error_log = "WTP the changes list is in debug.log, tag WTP. mods.bat -> «Забрать диагностику из игры» takes it out."
	debug_log = "WTP ==== BEGIN v5 ==== the plan against the saved one"
	every_in_global_list = {
		variable = bag_wtp_plan_touched
		clear_variable_list = bag_wtp_chg_out
		clear_variable_list = bag_wtp_chg_in
		set_variable = { name = bag_wtp_chg_n value = 0 }
		if = { limit = { is_target_in_variable_list = { name = bag_wtp_save_goods target = goods:clay } NOT = { is_target_in_variable_list = { name = bag_wtp_plan_goods target = goods:clay } } }
			add_to_variable_list = { name = bag_wtp_chg_out target = goods:clay }
			change_variable = { name = bag_wtp_chg_n add = 1 }
		}
		if = { limit = { is_target_in_variable_list = { name = bag_wtp_plan_goods target = goods:clay } NOT = { is_target_in_variable_list = { name = bag_wtp_save_goods target = goods:clay } } }
			add_to_variable_list = { name = bag_wtp_chg_in target = goods:clay }
			change_variable = { name = bag_wtp_chg_n add = 1 }
		}
		if = { limit = { is_target_in_variable_list = { name = bag_wtp_save_goods target = goods:coal } NOT = { is_target_in_variable_list = { name = bag_wtp_plan_goods target = goods:coal } } }
			add_to_variable_list = { name = bag_wtp_chg_out target = goods:coal }
			change_variable = { name = bag_wtp_chg_n add = 1 }
		}
		if = { limit = { is_target_in_variable_list = { name = bag_wtp_plan_goods target = goods:coal } NOT = { is_target_in_variable_list = { name = bag_wtp_save_goods target = goods:coal } } }
			add_to_variable_list = { name = bag_wtp_chg_in target = goods:coal }

			add_to_variable_list = { name = bag_wtp_chg_out target = goods:cotton }
			change_variable = { name = bag_wtp_chg_n add = 1 }
		}
		if = { limit = { is_target_in_variable_list = { name = bag_wtp_plan_goods target = goods:cotton } NOT = { is_target_in_variable_list = { name = bag_wtp_save_goods target = goods:cotton } } }
			add_to_variable_list = { name = bag_wtp_chg_in target = goods:cotton }
			change_variable = { name = bag_wtp_chg_n add = 1 }
		}

			if = { limit = { is_target_in_variable_list = { name = bag_wtp_save_goods target = goods:masonry } NOT = { is_target_in_variable_list = { name = bag_wtp_plan_goods target = goods:masonry } } } debug_log = "WTP LD -masonry" }
			if = { limit = { is_target_in_variable_list = { name = bag_wtp_plan_goods target = goods:masonry } NOT = { is_target_in_variable_list = { name = bag_wtp_save_goods target = goods:masonry } } } debug_log = "WTP LD +masonry" }
			if = { limit = { is_target_in_variable_list = { name = bag_wtp_save_goods target = goods:naval_supplies } NOT = { is_target_in_variable_list = { name = bag_wtp_plan_goods target = goods:naval_supplies } } } debug_log = "WTP LD -naval_supplies" }
			if = { limit = { is_target_in_variable_list = { name = bag_wtp_plan_goods target = goods:naval_supplies } NOT = { is_target_in_variable_list = { name = bag_wtp_save_goods target = goods:naval_supplies } } } debug_log = "WTP LD +naval_supplies" }
			if = { limit = { is_target_in_variable_list = { name = bag_wtp_save_goods target = goods:paper } NOT = { is_target_in_variable_list = { name = bag_wtp_plan_goods target = goods:paper } } } debug_log = "WTP LD -paper" }
			if = { limit = { is_target_in_variable_list = { name = bag_wtp_plan_goods target = goods:paper } NOT = { is_target_in_variable_list = { name = bag_wtp_save_goods target = goods:paper } } } debug_log = "WTP LD +paper" }
			if = { limit = { is_target_in_variable_list = { name = bag_wtp_save_goods target = goods:porcelain } NOT = { is_target_in_variable_list = { name = bag_wtp_plan_goods target = goods:porcelain } } } debug_log = "WTP LD -porcelain" }
			if = { limit = { is_target_in_variable_list = { name = bag_wtp_plan_goods target = goods:porcelain } NOT = { is_target_in_variable_list = { name = bag_wtp_save_goods target = goods:porcelain } } } debug_log = "WTP LD +porcelain" }
			if = { limit = { is_target_in_variable_list = { name = bag_wtp_save_goods target = goods:pottery } NOT = { is_target_in_variable_list = { name = bag_wtp_plan_goods target = goods:pottery } } } debug_log = "WTP LD -pottery" }
			if = { limit = { is_target_in_variable_list = { name = bag_wtp_plan_goods target = goods:pottery } NOT = { is_target_in_variable_list = { name = bag_wtp_save_goods target = goods:pottery } } } debug_log = "WTP LD +pottery" }
			if = { limit = { is_target_in_variable_list = { name = bag_wtp_save_goods target = goods:slaves_goods } NOT = { is_target_in_variable_list = { name = bag_wtp_plan_goods target = goods:slaves_goods } } } debug_log = "WTP LD -slaves_goods" }
			if = { limit = { is_target_in_variable_list = { name = bag_wtp_plan_goods target = goods:slaves_goods } NOT = { is_target_in_variable_list = { name = bag_wtp_save_goods target = goods:slaves_goods } } } debug_log = "WTP LD +slaves_goods" }
			if = { limit = { is_target_in_variable_list = { name = bag_wtp_save_goods target = goods:steel } NOT = { is_target_in_variable_list = { name = bag_wtp_plan_goods target = goods:steel } } } debug_log = "WTP LD -steel" }
			if = { limit = { is_target_in_variable_list = { name = bag_wtp_plan_goods target = goods:steel } NOT = { is_target_in_variable_list = { name = bag_wtp_save_goods target = goods:steel } } } debug_log = "WTP LD +steel" }
			if = { limit = { is_target_in_variable_list = { name = bag_wtp_save_goods target = goods:tar } NOT = { is_target_in_variable_list = { name = bag_wtp_plan_goods target = goods:tar } } } debug_log = "WTP LD -tar" }
			if = { limit = { is_target_in_variable_list = { name = bag_wtp_plan_goods target = goods:tar } NOT = { is_target_in_variable_list = { name = bag_wtp_save_goods target = goods:tar } } } debug_log = "WTP LD +tar" }
			if = { limit = { is_target_in_variable_list = { name = bag_wtp_save_goods target = goods:tools } NOT = { is_target_in_variable_list = { name = bag_wtp_plan_goods target = goods:tools } } } debug_log = "WTP LD -tools" }
			if = { limit = { is_target_in_variable_list = { name = bag_wtp_plan_goods target = goods:tools } NOT = { is_target_in_variable_list = { name = bag_wtp_save_goods target = goods:tools } } } debug_log = "WTP LD +tools" }
			if = { limit = { is_target_in_variable_list = { name = bag_wtp_save_goods target = goods:weaponry } NOT = { is_target_in_variable_list = { name = bag_wtp_plan_goods target = goods:weaponry } } } debug_log = "WTP LD -weaponry" }
			if = { limit = { is_target_in_variable_list = { name = bag_wtp_plan_goods target = goods:weaponry } NOT = { is_target_in_variable_list = { name = bag_wtp_save_goods target = goods:weaponry } } } debug_log = "WTP LD +weaponry" }
		}
	}
	debug_log = "WTP ==== END v5 ===="
}

# The slots' counters, created before anything can read one.
#
# **`_sl<n>_n` is what «загрузить» tests before it throws the plan away**, and a
# `limit` that reads a global which is not there fails silently -- so an
# uninitialised slot would either read as empty for ever or clear a good plan for
# nothing. Written with `has_global_variable` so a save from an older build gains
# the slots without losing the one plan it had.
# Scope: country
bag_wtp_edit_init_slots = {
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { has_global_variable = bag_wtp_sl1_n } }
		set_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_sl1_n value = 0 }
		set_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_sl1_locn value = 0 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { has_global_variable = bag_wtp_sl2_n } }
		set_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_sl2_n value = 0 }
		set_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_sl2_locn value = 0 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { has_global_variable = bag_wtp_sl3_n } }
		set_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_sl3_n value = 0 }
		set_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_sl3_locn value = 0 }
	}
	# `_edit_done` and `_edit_good` are read by `bag_wtp_edit_last_label` every
	# frame the editor is open, and the pool is read by its datamodel. A list is created by
	# clearing it, and it must be cleared only once ever: doing it on every open
	# would throw away the goods he had picked.
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { has_global_variable = bag_wtp_edit_done } }
		set_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_edit_done value = 0 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { has_global_variable = bag_wtp_edit_reached } }
		set_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_edit_reached value = 0 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { has_global_variable_list = bag_wtp_edit_pool } }
		clear_global_variable_list = bag_wtp_edit_pool
	}
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { has_global_variable_list = bag_wtp_chg_locs } }
		clear_global_variable_list = bag_wtp_chg_locs
	}
}

# The editor's window. **The plan on the map is what it edits**, so opening it
# neither plans nor loads: it fills the picker from the ground the last plan
# scored and shows whatever the plan holds now.
# Scope: country
bag_wtp_open_edit_window_effect = {
	# **The probe that lived here is gone and `check_script.py` holds its answer.**
	# It logged one line a press, to separate "the button never reached the effect"
	# from "the effect ran and the window did not draw". The log said the effect
	# ran, the `.gui` had no error of any kind, and the window still did not exist:
	# nothing had registered it in `gui/scripted_widgets/`, and the engine creates
	# only what is registered there. That is a rule a checker can enforce, so it
	# does, and a line in `error.log` on every press is noise once the answer is in.
	bag_wtp_edit_init_slots = yes
	bag_wtp_edit_fill_pool = yes
	bag_wtp_plan_show = yes
	remove_variable = bag_wtp_result_open
	remove_variable = bag_wtp_right_open
	remove_variable = bag_wtp_plan_open
	bag_wtp_hide_results = yes
	set_variable = { name = bag_wtp_edit_open value = 1 }
}

# Scope: country
bag_wtp_close_edit_window_effect = {
	remove_variable = bag_wtp_edit_open
	remove_variable = bag_wtp_chg_open
	bag_wtp_plan_hide = yes
	clear_global_variable_list = bag_wtp_chg_locs
}

# «Показать изменения», and the window it opens. **The list is built here and
# not by the window**, because a datamodel cannot ask two variable lists to
# differ -- the effect does the comparing and leaves the answer on the locations.
# Scope: country
bag_wtp_open_changes_window_effect = {
	bag_wtp_edit_changes = yes
	set_variable = { name = bag_wtp_chg_open value = 1 }
}

# Scope: country
bag_wtp_close_changes_window_effect = {
	remove_variable = bag_wtp_chg_open
	clear_global_variable_list = bag_wtp_chg_locs
}
